question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
-- Verify all 5 top products
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING 1.0 * sales_q4_2020 / sales_q4_2019 >= 1.20
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales
),
product_total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as total_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as total_q4_2020,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as overall_total
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name
),
top_20pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM (
        SELECT prod_id, overall_total,
            NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY overall_total DESC) as tile
        FROM product_total_sales
    )
    WHERE tile = 1
),
grand_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(amount_sold) FILTER (WHERE t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772) as grand_q4_2019,
        SUM(amount_sold) FILTER (WHERE t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776) as grand_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
)
SELECT 
    pts.prod_id,
    pts.prod_name,
    ROUND(pts.total_q4_2019 * 1.0 / gt.grand_q4_2019, 6) as share_q4_2019,
    ROUND(pts.total_q4_2020 * 1.0 / gt.grand_q4_2020, 6) as share_q4_2020,
    ROUND(pts.total_q4_2020 * 1.0 / gt.grand_q4_2020 - pts.total_q4_2019 * 1.0 / gt.grand_q4_2019, 6) as share_change
FROM product_total_sales pts
JOIN top_20pct t20 ON pts.prod_id = t20.prod_id
CROSS JOIN grand_totals gt
ORDER BY share_change DESC
